about: Differences between the Node server and the Bun twin (the Node source compiled by the pinned Bun in .bun-version), each with the runtime reason. One entry is one request or one path. Regenerate with --a=node --b=bun --record-expected=<file>; a run fails when an entry no longer differs, so the list may only shrink.

differences.reason: The operating-system error text for a 5,000-character slug names the failing call differently in each runtime.
The runtimes have different call-stack depths; Node fails a request nested thousands deep with a stack-overflow error, Bun answers it.
